title: Way Out
story:
A young man was walking through a crowded market.

He saw something he wanted.

It was not his.

No one was watching.

For a moment, he was tempted.

His mind said,

“Just take it.”

“No one will know.”

But then he paused.

He remembered what was right.

He looked around again.

This time, he noticed something else.

A small sign nearby said,

“CCTV in operation.”

He stepped back.

He walked away.

Later, he realized something important.

There was always a way out.

He just needed to choose it.

In life, we all face temptation.

Sometimes it feels strong.

Sometimes it feels easy to give in.

But God is faithful.

He never allows us to be tested beyond what we can handle.

He always provides a way out.

We only need to look for it.

And choose it.
life_lesson:
Temptation will come, but God always provides a way out.

Choose the right path, even when it is difficult.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being faithful in every situation.

When I face temptation, help me to pause and choose what is right.

Give me strength to walk away from wrong choices.

Open my eyes to see the way out You provide.

Help me to honor You in all I do.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What temptation do you struggle with the most?

Do you notice the way out God provides?

What choice can you make today to follow the right path?
verse:
No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind.
And God is faithful.
He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear.
But when you are tempted, He will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.
